description: Poverty and lack of opportunity combine with expectations that young women financially support their families, which has driven thousands to seek their fortune abroad. The pressure is familial before it is criminal.
energy_note: Sent, by people who love her, to earn.

aspect: The returnee who tells the truth is not believed
description: A woman who comes back with nothing is read as having failed or having been foolish, not as having been trafficked - so her account does not deter the next departure.
energy_note: Warning them, and being heard as making excuses.

aspect: Campaigns aimed at awareness miss the actual variable
description: Where the choice is between a known risk abroad and a certainty at home, more information about the risk does not change the decision. Changing the alternative would.
energy_note: She is not uninformed. She is out of options.

aspect: SCENARIO - the aunt with the good contact
description: Her aunt knows a woman whose daughter is in Oman and sends money every month. The agency in Benin City has an office, a sign and a receipt book. She is nineteen. Everything about it looks like a job, because on paper it is one.
energy_note: A registered agency, a signed contract, a receipt.

aspect: SCENARIO - the WhatsApp voice note from Muscat
description: Her friend sends a two-minute voice note that is mostly fine and has eleven seconds in the middle that are not. She listens to it four times. She has already paid the agency NGN 450,000 and her flight is on the 14th.
energy_note: Eleven seconds of warning, and a non-refundable deposit.
